concepts.gloss_en: menstrual blood (aspect of the Shekhinah's defilement/separation from blemished covenant)

reason_for_human: All four occurrences are the identical construct phrase 'menstrual blood' in the same passage (LM 29), used consistently as the Kabbalistic aspect of the Shekhinah's defilement/redness tied to the blemished covenant. The only variation (דַּם vs דָּם) is trivial pausal/plene pointing of the same word, not a homograph. Single concept, no split needed.
